chief_complaint: Evaluation and management of advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with pending kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 49‑year‑old man with a long‑standing history of hypertension, obesity, and type 2 diabetes‑related kidney disease that has progressed from CKD stage 1 in 2011 to stage 4 in late 2022. He is currently listed as awaiting kidney transplantation (since Dec 2022). Recent issues include anemia diagnosed in Oct 2022, ongoing proteinuria and microalbuminuria, chronic low‑back pain managed with high‑dose opioid therapy (fentanyl patch, oxycodone, Percocet), daily tobacco use, and psychosocial stressors (intimate partner abuse, criminal record, military background). He works full‑time and is attempting smoking cessation with a nicotine patch. Laboratory and vital‑sign data are missing, limiting assessment of disease control.

active_problems.name: Proteinuria due to type 2 diabetes mellitus
